0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Chicago Bulls visit the Toronto Raptors. The Bulls list Isaac Okoro (undisclosed), Nic Claxton (hamstring), Tobe Awaka (knee) and Zach Collins (toe, after surgery) as day-to-day, while the Raptors are without Brandon Ingram (Achilles, after surgery), and Chucky Hepburn (hamstring) and Nate Bittle (foot) are also listed as day-to-day. Chicago lost all three meetings with Toronto in the 2025-26 season, including the most recent one, a 139-109 defeat in Chicago on March 18, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Bulls a 25% chance to win this game.
